mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (as of t-1mo) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% (as of t-1mo), it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (as of t-1mo), the 5-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a federal funds rate above 3.0% and CPI inflation above 195.0 (both as of t-1mo) indicates a stagflationary environment that increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 195.0 (as of t-1mo), the 20-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% (as of t-1mo), it signals a deepening recession that has already been priced into the market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is expected to cut rates.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% (as of t-1mo), the 20-day forward returns are negative, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (as of t-1mo) indicates strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS (as of t-1mo) and 60-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 2000 (as of t-2mo), it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 2000 (as of t-2mo), the 5-day forward returns are negative, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong housing starts (HOUST > 2000) and robust retail sales (RSAFS > 340000) as of t-2mo and t-1mo, respectively, indicates a broad-based economic expansion that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 2000 AND RSAFS > 340000 (as of t-2mo and t-1mo, respectively), the 60-day forward returns are negative, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 115 (as of t-1mo), it signals a deepening economic slowdown that has been overpriced by the market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is expected to implement stimulus.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 115 (as of t-1mo), the 60-day forward returns are negative, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
